scope: All model buildings and source roads, plus footpaths, waters and sports areas. No category is marked complete by unit-test success.
limitations: Building records are preprocessing metadata; bespoke rendered heights and geometry are not measured here.
OSM snapshot date is unknown; links identify ways, not proof of current accuracy.
2025 imagery cannot prove 2026 construction or access status.
Intersection candidates are diagnostic leads, not confirmed wall collisions.

fitReport.interpretation: Footpath checks are about 2–4 m; the northern road check differs by about 13 m. The outline is only a notice reference area, never a physical barrier.
